meta.title: Mobilcab roadmap — what we ship, and in what order
meta.description: Mobilcab ships in stages: cut lists, nesting, CNC, team, then AI. Paid plans follow Cut list → Atelier → CNC → Production → AI. No fake dates — just order and status.

hero.label: Product roadmap
hero.title: Mobilcab stages — in the order we ship them.
hero.body: We build in order: workshop basics first (design + cut lists), then the next stage only when the current one is stable on real projects. We don't announce everything at once.

stages.title: Cut list — 3D design + parts list
stages.body: Design furniture in 3D, save to the cloud, and get the parts list — what you cut in the workshop. That's the foundation: without a cut list, the project isn't worth investing in. Now it's on the Free plan (no export limit). When billing opens, Cut list also exists as a paid plan with unlimited exports.

stages.title: Nesting + labels + quotes
stages.body: Lay parts on sheets, print labels, and work out costs so you can give the client a clear quote. On Pricing, that's the Atelier plan (Cut list + nesting + labels + quotes) when the stage is ready — not necessarily the same day as the first paid Cut list plan.

stages.title: CNC export
stages.body: Machine files once nesting is solid. On Pricing: the CNC plan (Atelier + CNC export). A repeatable flow — not “every CNC in the world” on day one.

stages.title: Team and sharing
stages.body: Workshop work with roles, invites, and a view-only link for the client — without opening the whole shop to them. On Pricing: the Production plan (CNC + team).

stages.title: AI + renders
stages.body: A layout assistant and visuals for presentations. On Pricing: the AI plan (Production + AI + renders) — extras that don't block the core workshop stages.

a: They're the stages on this page, in order. M1 = Cut list. M2 = nesting, labels and quotes (Atelier plan). M3 = CNC export (CNC plan). M4 = team (Production plan). M5 = AI + renders (AI plan).
Elsewhere on the site we talk about subscriptions and paid launch, not M-codes.
So you get something useful in the workshop sooner — not a half-finished tool on every front. Each stage has to stand on its own before we open the next one.

When we open billing: Free gets 3 downloads, and the paid Cut list plan keeps unlimited exports. Nesting comes on the Atelier plan when that stage is ready. Founding Partner: 20% / 6 months for people on the list; the list closes at billing. Anyone who subscribes later pays list price.
After design, cut lists and nesting are stable on real projects. CNC export without reliable nesting only frustrates you at the machine — that's why it's stage three (M3), not stage one.

items.q: Can I use design only for now?
a: Yes. M1 (Cut list: 3D design + parts list) is the foundation we launch first. You can work with it without waiting for nesting, CNC or AI.

items.q: Is there a fixed date for each stage?
a: No. We don't publish a fixed calendar. We announce each stage when it's stable on real projects — not when it looks good on paper.

items.q: What happens to my projects when subscriptions open?
a: Your projects stay. When subscriptions open, Free gets 3 downloads per account. On the paid Cut list plan and later paid plans, exports stay unlimited.

items.q: Is Founding Partner tied to a stage?
a: No. Founding Partner is a separate program: free to join only before billing, then 20% / 6 months on paid plans. It closes when billing opens — it is not an M1–M5 stage.

cta.title: Design and cut lists — ready to use.
cta.body: The app is free now. Later stages come when they're stable on real projects.
